text:
marco (finance): Quick announcement: we're standardizing promotional credit expirations and introducing a short auto-rollforward for tiny overages to reduce noisy billing tickets. This affects Hosted and Trial promos only. Internal RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/billing/promo-rollforward (internal)
deploy-bot: Staged broadcast scheduled: 2026-04-02T16:00:00Z to Hosted customers tier A/B/C. Email template: billing/promo-rollforward-v2
anya (billing): TL;DR of changes:
- All new promotional credits -> unified 9-month expiry from grant date (old grants varied 3/6/12).
- Auto-rollforward: single-charge overages under $3 will be converted into a positive account balance if the customer has activity in the next 96 hours; otherwise standard invoice flow applies.
devin (eng): For engineering: we'll need two new invoice metadata fields and a flag in the billing API: promo_expires_iso, rollforward_applied (true/false), and feature flag billing.promo.rollforward.enabled.
lisa (support): Can you draft short copy for support replies? We already get "why is my credit gone" messages.
marco (finance): Yes. I'll add a Support Playbook in #support-playbooks with suggested responses, examples, and an escalation path for disputed rollforwards.
sam (acct mgmt): Heads-up: negotiated contracts & Dedicated reserved customers should be excluded. We need a list of accounts to exempt; I'll upload to billing profiles under "promo_exempt".
anya (billing): Implementation notes:
- Normalization window: existing legacy promo expiries will be mapped to the new 9-month expiry on 2026-05-15 unless the account is in promo_exempt.
- Rollforward only applies to Hosted usage plans and trials, not to Dedicated/reserved billing.
- Accounting: rollforward converted amounts will show as "account_credit_adjustment" line items.
devin (eng): We'll add UX in the billing page to show the "promo_expires_iso" and a hover tooltip explaining rollforward behavior. PR target: 2026-04-08.
lisa (support): Any guidance on refunds vs rollforward? Customers may expect refunds for small mistakes.
marco (finance): Default is rollforward to local account credit. Refunds remain possible for qualifying cases after review; playbook will include criteria.
sam (acct mgmt): I'll message the enterprise AMs to gather any exceptions. If anyone has large accounts with bespoke promo terms, please flag them in the "hold-promo-normalize" sheet by EOD 2026-04-03.
deploy-bot: Rollout phases: internal docs + support playbook 2026-04-02 -> UI flags & feature-gate 2026-04-08 -> normalize existing promos 2026-05-15.
anya (billing): Example invoice fragment we'll emit (strings only):
"line_item: promotional_credit | amount: -50.00 | promo_expires_iso: 2026-12-10 | rollforward_applied: false"
"line_item: usage_overage | amount: 2.45 | rollforward_applied: true | account_credit_adjustment: -2.45"
devin (eng): Noted. We'll make sure the billing API accepts string fields for those keys and returns them in the GET /invoices endpoint.
marco (finance): Thanks all. We'll publish the external FAQ and customer email copy tomorrow morning. Ping me if you need a copy for your channel. :sparkles:
